common.animation.RandomPath

public class RandomPath extends Object implements JobPath
Created by IntelliJ IDEA. User: OrsotronIII Date: 1-mar-2005 Time: 16.00.00 This class implements methods to get a jobanimation to run by -and impredictible- randomized paths in its queue net.
